title: Spider venom kills varroa mites without harming honeybees
summary: Researchers discovered that spider venom can effectively kill varroa mites, a devastating parasite responsible for honeybee colony collapse, while leaving the bees unharmed. This breakthrough offers a natural, targeted approach to pest control in beekeeping without the collateral damage of traditional chemical treatments.
problem_solved: Provides a bee-safe method to control varroa mites that threaten global honeybee populations and food security through pollination.
why_valuable: It offers a natural alternative to chemical pesticides that are harmful to bees, potentially preventing colony collapse disorder while maintaining ecosystem safety.
